arabic: طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ.
translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) performed Tawaf on a camel. Every time he reached the Corner (the Black Stone), he pointed to it with something he had and said 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Most Great).
